title: Blue Raffia Platforms That Feel Like Vacation
subtitle: The kind of slides that make a linen midi feel like Capri at golden hour.
story: Some shoes carry a feeling. These powder-blue raffia platforms feel like the slow exhale of a long lunch by the sea — woven texture, soft denim-blue tone, the kind of subtle lift that lengthens the leg without making a show of it. They land somewhere between a designer summer slide and an espadrille, and they pair effortlessly with a linen maxi or cropped wide-leg trousers. The price tag, on the other hand, doesn't whisper resort at all — $40 on Amazon.

products.name: Monrovia Platform Raffia Slides
products.description: Hand-woven raffia upper on a flatform sole in a soft, dusty blue that reads like washed linen.

styling_tips.label: On Sizing
styling_tips.text: Reviews lean toward true-to-size for narrow to medium feet; if you're between sizes or have a wider foot, size up half. The raffia softens after a few wears.

styling_tips.label: Color Pairing
styling_tips.text: Powder blue acts like a neutral against cream, sand, and warm taupe. Try them with a linen midi, a white poplin shirt and wide-leg trousers, or layered over a slip dress in butter yellow.

styling_tips.label: From Beach to Bistro
styling_tips.text: The flatform makes them dressier than a flat slide — pair with a straw tote and gold hoops for an aperitivo, or with a soft cotton dress for a long Mediterranean lunch.

meta_description: Powder-blue raffia platform slides that feel like Capri at golden hour. Hand-woven texture, linen-soft tone, and a flatform that flatters a midi — under $40.
